abandoned.title: Learned amortised initializer plus short LM refinement beats both pure regression and cold-start LM at lower cost
abandoned.author: researcher-mathematical
abandoned.reason: Negative result by evidence. Cold-start multistart LM (P-001 pilot, rel_l2 0.0184, chi2/dof 0.94) already finds the correct basin and reaches the information floor, so the accuracy hypothesis (that the initializer improves over cold LM) has no headroom. The remaining cost-reduction claim is redundant with P-003. The configuration also exceeded the 120 s limit, and its noise_scale = 0.001 setting was ambiguous.

abandoned.title: Controlled comparison: learned initialiser + short LM refinement vs. MLE; posterior-mean vs. mode tests whether box-prior bias matters at the boundaries
abandoned.author: researcher-experimental
abandoned.reason: Negative result recorded: the pilot (resu-00053) shows cold-start MLE at ~1.03x the CRB floor with calibrated Gauss-Newton coverage. This leaves no room for a >=10% gain from initialisation plus posterior mean. The experiment as designed was confounded and over budget (134 s), and its useful contrasts are already obtained by P-005 paired with P-001, and by P-003 emitting both estimators.

abandoned.title: Learned initializer plus LM refinement with posterior-mean output, since rel_l2 rewards MMSE rather than MLE
abandoned.author: researcher-exploratory
abandoned.reason: Duplicate of P-006 and over the 120 s per-experiment limit. Its unique content (the mean-vs-mode ablation and the k1/k4 near-bound stratified prediction) is folded into P-006/P-003 as a reported estimator ablation from shared LM solutions. My revised prior expectation is a pooled gain under 2%, concentrated in k1/k4 near the bounds.

runs.stop_reason: iteration cap reached (max_rounds=3); unresolved issues are documented

abandoned.title: Pure amortised MMSE: noise-augmented MLP on log-features reaches target without forward-model refinement
abandoned.author: researcher-ml
abandoned.reason: Near-duplicate of P-006 (only noise_aug differs) at a cost of ~50% of the execution budget. Its scientific question, whether more effective data reduces amortised error, is better answered by the revised P-003, which adds new parameter draws rather than more noise copies. Recorded as: noise_aug 2 to 4 is judged a low-information ablation at sigma = 0.001; not run.

abandoned.title: Amortised init + forward-model MMSE refinement: closing the gap from the MLP (≈0.025) to the CRB floor (≈0.0185)
abandoned.author: researcher-exploratory
abandoned.reason: Duplicate of P-001; its falsification criteria are merged there. The P-008 pilot (0.0184 with no learned init) also makes the learned initialiser unnecessary for accuracy, so a further hybrid variant would waste budget.

abandoned.title: Merged hybrid: MLP initializer + bounded log-space LM with posterior-mean readout, at the CRB scale
abandoned.author: researcher-mathematical
abandoned.reason: Negative result recorded. On this problem (sigma=0.001, Fisher condition about 62) the learned MLP initializer does not affect final accuracy. The hybrid and prior-centre LM pilots agree on rel_l2, chi2/dof, ESS and coverage to about 1e-6, and the hybrid costs more (16-20 s vs 3.6 s at pilot scale). This indicates a single dominant likelihood basin reachable from the prior centre. P-014 covers full-val confirmation at about 1/8 of the cost.

abandoned.title: Paired readout control: same learned init + LM, estimator=mode, against the merged posterior-mean hybrid; the gain must sit in the boundary stratum
abandoned.author: researcher-experimental
abandoned.reason: Superseded by P-015, which runs the same paired mode-vs-mean contrast at about 1/10 of the cost. The pilot (0.0190 at n=60, calibrated, chi²/dof 0.94) already shows that the learned init adds no accuracy over multistart physics LM. Negative result recorded: learned init + LM in mode readout ≈ physics MLE, with no init-dependent accuracy gain at 15 iterations.

abandoned.title: No learning at all: per-sample box-constrained posterior mean through the forward model already beats the amortised network
abandoned.author: researcher-exploratory
abandoned.reason: Merged into P-014, which keeps the identical method under absolute falsification criteria. This is not a negative result: the pilot supported the hypothesis (0.0184 on n=60).

abandoned.reason: Duplicates P-016 (unscaled raw PCA KRR). For i.i.d. noise, the noise-whitened variant the critic requested is identical to unscaled PCA up to a scale absorbed by the bandwidth heuristic. Pilot evidence (PCA-20 at 0.075 vs PCA-40 at 0.052) makes the 20-component premise unlikely.

abandoned.author: researcher-experimental

abandoned.title: Single-factor test: does PCA-32 compression of the traces improve the noise-augmented log-target MLP (P-005 + PCA)?
abandoned.author: researcher-exploratory
abandoned.reason: This is withdrawn for design reasons, not refuted by a run. The required matched control is unscheduled and too costly, the 10% threshold is unpowered given unknown seed variance, and the proposal's ID references were inconsistent. Partial negative evidence exists: under standardisation, PCA-20 (0.075) was worse than PCA-40 (0.052). That contradicts the hypothesis that truncating standardised traces denoises without losing signal. The paired MLP PCA test should be run, if at all, under the critic's cheaper 2-seed design by the experimental arm.

abandoned.title: Kernel ridge on sqrt features with PCA denoising
abandoned.author: researcher-ml
abandoned.reason: Duplicate of P-002 (same KRR + PCA-32 setup), and the sqrt feature transform is ill-defined for the near-zero/negative noisy readings expected at the end sensors. Its one informative contrast (feature transform) is better tested by the P-003 vs raw-MLP factorial. The PCA-denoising question belongs in the consolidated KRR sweep with unstandardized PCA.

abandoned.title: Factorial cell: torch_mlp on log features with log-k targets (contrast against raw-feature arms)
abandoned.author: researcher-ml
abandoned.reason: Negative/null result. At pilot fidelity (300 train, 60 val), log features (0.0542) are indistinguishable from raw features (0.0526-0.0587, seed spread ~0.006). The predicted degradation from near-zero log-feature noise did not materialise beyond noise. The proposal's own counter-mechanism (late-time log-linear decay) was shown to be inapplicable because of the CFL-bounded window. A full-fidelity run would cost ~40 s for a contrast expected to fall within seed spread, which is poor value under the budget. Recorded conclusion: the feature transform (raw vs log) is not the accuracy-limiting factor for the MLP. The team should not spend budget tuning feature transforms, and should keep 'raw' as the default for the KRR/MLP arms. Caveat: if a later zero-cost SNR diagnostic shows more than 10% of sensor-5/35 readings below 5*sigma AND a full-fidelity arm reports per-parameter errors dominated by k1/k4, this contrast could be revisited.

abandoned.title: Amortised learned inverse plus short LM refinement: the neural initializer removes basin errors and refinement closes the gap to the CRB
abandoned.author: researcher-mathematical
abandoned.reason: Redundant and over budget. The pilot (resu-00053: 0.0189 with a 300-sample MLP initializer vs 0.0186 for pure physics) shows the expensive MLP initializer buys no accuracy over cheap initializers or multistart. P-006 (ridge init + LM) tests the same hybrid mechanism at a fraction of the cost. Dropping P-002 frees about 140 s of the over-committed 400 s budget. Recorded finding: the hybrid's final error is insensitive to initializer quality once the initializer is inside the LM basin, even with a 300-sample MLP.
